probes.name: worksheet-bold-no-cf
probes.source:
Public LastCaller As String
Public LastDetail As String
Public Calls As Long
Function CallerBold() As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
Calls=Calls+1
LastCaller=TypeName(Application.Caller)
LastDetail="before"
CallerBold=Application.Caller.DisplayFormat.Font.Bold
LastDetail="bold=" & CStr(CallerBold)
Exit Function
Failed:
LastDetail="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
CallerBold=CVErr(2015)
End Function
Function CallerText() As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
Calls=Calls+1
LastCaller=TypeName(Application.Caller)
LastDetail="before"
CallerText=Application.Caller.Text
LastDetail="text=" & CStr(CallerText)
Exit Function
Failed:
LastDetail="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
CallerText=CVErr(2015)
End Function
Function TextNumber() As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
Calls=Calls+1
LastCaller=TypeName(Application.Caller)
LastDetail="text=" & Application.Caller.Text
TextNumber=20
Exit Function
Failed:
LastDetail="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
TextNumber=CVErr(2015)
End Function
Function CellState() As String
Dim v As Variant,shown As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=Range("A1").Value2
shown=Range("A1").DisplayFormat.Font.Bold
CellState="value=" & CStr(v) & ";vartype=" & VarType(v) & ";text=" & Range("A1").Text & ";bold=" & CStr(shown)
CellState=CellState & ";caller=" & LastCaller & ";detail=" & LastDetail & ";called=" & CStr(Calls>0)
Exit Function
Failed:
CellState="SNAP-ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ";caller=" & LastCaller & ";detail=" & LastDetail
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim f As FormatCondition
On Error GoTo Failed
Range("A1").Formula="=CallerBold()"
Application.CalculateFull
Probe=CellState()
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ";caller=" & LastCaller & ";detail=" & LastDetail
End Function
